draft.emotion: earnest and direct, expressing a personal need or desire
notes: Present tense: chcę, chcesz, chce, chcemy, chcecie, chcą. Imperfective verb (perfective: zechcieć).
Followed by an infinitive ('chcę odpocząć'), the genitive for uncountable or abstract things ('chcę spokoju'), or the accusative for specific countable items ('chcę tę książkę').
The impersonal reflexive phrase 'chce mi się' (+ infinitive or genitive) is very common and means 'I feel like' (e.g., 'Chce mi się spać' — I feel like sleeping).

draftBefore.emotion: earnest and direct, expressing a personal need or desire
notes: Chcieć is an irregular verb. In the present tense, it follows: chcę, chcesz, chce, chcemy, chcecie, chcą.
It is followed by the infinitive of another verb to express what you want to do (e.g., 'chcę iść' - I want to go).
Use the genitive case after 'chcieć' when you want to express wanting an object (e.g., 'chcę kawy' - I want [some] coffee).

faults.quote: Use the genitive case after 'chcieć' when you want to express wanting an object
faults.why: Misleading: concrete countable nouns regularly take the accusative (e.g. 'chcę nową książkę').
